facts.label: Mudanças em andamento
facts.sub: Use are/is + -ing para mudanças agora e um comparativo para dizer como: Weddings are becoming smaller. It is getting more modern. Use than para comparar.

facts.label: estão mudando
facts.sub: Use are/is + verbo com -ing para mudanças que acontecem agora: Traditions are changing. Weddings are becoming smaller. O -ing mostra o processo em andamento.

facts.label: está ficando mais…
facts.sub: Use get + comparativo para a mudança: It is getting bigger. The shops are getting more modern. Para adjetivos curtos use -er; para longos use more.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: Denver is called the Mile High City.
items.why: It is about one mile above sea level.
It is near the Rocky Mountains.

items.s: Cities can change and keep traditions at the same time.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Denver is called the Mile High City. → Verdadeiro (It is about one mile above sea level.)
Denver is on the coast. → Falso (It is near the Rocky Mountains.)
Cities can change and keep traditions at the same time. → Verdadeiro (Many do both.)

pages.title: A busy street in Denver · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a cold, clear afternoon in Denver. Luisa meets Elena near the mountains. The city is growing every year. New buildings are going up downtown. The two friends talk about old and new ways. Life is not the same as before.

“Traditions are changing fast in Denver. Families are cooking less at home.” says Elena. “Yes, my generation is ordering more food. It is more simple than cooking.” says Luisa. “Younger people are getting married later. Weddings are becoming smaller, too.” says Elena.
